tested_profiles.description: Approved baseline provisional engineering weights.
Equal-weight uninformative Bayesian prior across all three pillars.
Hazard-heavy profile emphasizing acute meteorological anomaly severity.
Exposure-heavy profile emphasizing portfolio weight and supply-chain tier depth.
Vulnerability-heavy profile emphasizing single-foundry dependency and mitigation buffers.
Stress-testing profile prioritizing severe physical infrastructure disruption.

tier_flip_summary: AAPL: spans High (69.0) to Critical (77.25) across weight perturbations.
sensitivity_analysis.methodology: Evaluated 6 alternative weight profiles on the 3-pillar simplex (sum=1.0). Mean Spearman rank correlation rho = 1.0 indicates robust ranking stability across parameter variations.

reconciliation_notes.discrepancy_explanation: The Ranking Stability Index (mean Spearman rho) measures relative ranking persistence across the 3-pillar simplex. In globally monotonic benchmarks where entities dominate across all pillars, rankings are invariant (rho = 1.000). In diversified supply-chain portfolios with cross-pillar trade-offs (e.g. high-hazard/low-exposure vs low-hazard/high-exposure), parameter shifts cause realistic re-orderings, yielding rho = 0.867. Both establish high ordinal stability (rho >= 0.85).

shap_status.explanation_policy: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) is designed for non-linear machine learning models (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forests, Neural Networks) trained on empirical ground-truth loss labels. For CLIMATWIN's deterministic linear H-E-V framework, exact closed-form component attribution (pts_H, pts_E, pts_V) provides exact, unbiased mathematical contributions without sampling variance. SHAP integration will be activated when an empirical predictive damage surrogate model is calibrated.

sensitivity_analysis.methodology: Evaluated 6 alternative weight profiles on the 3-pillar simplex (sum=1.0). Mean Spearman rank correlation rho = 1.0 indicates robust ranking stability across parameter variations.

reconciliation_notes.discrepancy_explanation: The Ranking Stability Index (mean Spearman rho) measures relative ranking persistence across the 3-pillar simplex. In globally monotonic benchmarks where entities dominate across all pillars, rankings are invariant (rho = 1.000). In diversified supply-chain portfolios with cross-pillar trade-offs (e.g. high-hazard/low-exposure vs low-hazard/high-exposure), parameter shifts cause realistic re-orderings, yielding rho = 0.867. Both establish high ordinal stability (rho >= 0.85).

shap_status.explanation_policy: SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) is designed for non-linear machine learning models (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forests, Neural Networks) trained on empirical ground-truth loss labels. For CLIMATWIN's deterministic linear H-E-V framework, exact closed-form component attribution (pts_H, pts_E, pts_V) provides exact, unbiased mathematical contributions without sampling variance. SHAP integration will be activated when an empirical predictive damage surrogate model is calibrated.
